{"subject":"Quick check-in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last spoke, and I wanted to check in and hear how things are going at Weaviate. I'd love to catch up on what the team has been building and what's on your mind for the months ahead.

If useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call at whatever time suits you. Just reply with a couple of slots that work and I'll send an invite.

Hope all is well with you and the team.

Elena"}
